decisions.reason: The original F8/2.1 composes a merely Lebesgue-measurable density with a Borel residual map into the Borel sigma-algebra. Those sigma-algebras do not match, and the uncompleted product need not measure the resulting product. A non-Borel null-set perturbation q2=phi+1_A yields the sheared term 1_A(x2-x1). If it were product-measurable, its Borel modification outside null coordinate slabs, integrated along (t,t+a), would make 1_A(a) Borel, a contradiction. The repair proves the original product formula for Borel densities, and for arbitrary versions proves existence of a Borel product density plus equality of the original formula on the completed product. Countable Choice is stated exactly for the existing representative/completion suppliers; no model or density version is silently discarded.

The cited path really can end through a child of w: l→c→w, l→a→b and w→b gives l–a–b–w. The original universal assertion in step 5.1 is false. The separator itself remains correct, because the first-collider argument already given for the opposite endpoint applies verbatim from w whenever l is its nondescendant nonparent. This is a local proof gap a competent reader closes by that symmetry, not a false reversal conclusion or missing substantive supplier. Step 5.1 now supplies the common parent-separator argument for both orientations, explicitly covering paths through children. Reachability maximality and the lift past deleted sinks are also made explicit. The density supplier repair is carried through the separate Borel/Countable Choice alternative without changing the reversed-edge or conditioning-set conclusion.

outside_lane_alerts.finding: If p denotes an arbitrary positive version of the joint density, the every-section assertion is false, even with Gaussian Borel noises. With independent standard Gaussian noises take s a separate root, y a root, z=y+Nz and d=z+Nd. On s=0 alone replace the product density by phi(0)phi(z)phi(y)phi(d-y). This is still a positive Borel density of the same observational law, with 0<p_S(0)=phi(0)<infinity, but at s=0 it makes d=y+independent Gaussian, so d and y are dependent given z. This precise version issue disappears when p is explicitly the structural Borel product version, as the consuming restricted-model proof already intends.
outside_lane_alerts.minimality: Owner should explicitly bind p and its marginals to the structural product version, preserving the strongest every-positive-section conclusion. Do not replace that conclusion by an almost-everywhere-s statement merely to avoid the version discipline.
